# Draft:Edward Thommes

Edward "The Promise" Thommes is an American mixed martial artist who competes in the featherweight division. He has competed professionally in organizations including Bellator MMA, Global Knockout, WXC, X-1 World Events, Pancrase, Destiny MMA, and other regional promotions in the United States.
Mixed martial arts career
Early career
Thommes began his professional mixed martial arts career competing in regional promotions across the United States. He built an early undefeated record while competing primarily in Hawaii-based organizations before expanding to larger regional and international events.
Pancrase and regional competition
Thommes competed internationally in Pancrase, where he earned a submission victory over Japanese fighter Kosuke Terashima. He continued to compete in promotions including Destiny MMA and Global Knockout, accumulating wins across multiple events.
Bellator MMA
Thommes competed for Bellator MMA at Bellator 212 in Honolulu, Hawaii, where he faced Toby Misech in a featherweight bout. The fight ended via technical knockout in the third round following a sustained exchange between both fighters.
The bout gained significant online attention, with footage surpassing 4 million views on YouTube. Thommes remained active throughout the contest, continuing to press forward until the referee stoppage.
Recent competition
Thommes most recently competed in Detroit, Michigan, against Darius Estell at WXC 77: Warrior Wednesday 2, where he won the bout via unanimous decision.
